name: dsh-memory
description: Capability memory for DSH: mine finished sessions for reusable skills (SKILL.md) and negative paths (negatives.jsonl). Reads the handoff ledger as a file contract; imports nothing from the slicing plugin.
notes: Decoupling contract: reads .retired.json / .transferred.json from the slicing plugin's dataDir. No code import in either direction.
Skills are written as SKILL.md into the DSH skill directory, so the next generation picks them up with no plugin installed.
M1 scope: harvest + extract CLI. Retrieval-at-pre-step and the flywheel scoring are M3/M4.
